caption:
You can't just lose — some part of you needs to be seen winning.

Which one rules you right now — Indra who needs to win, or the part of you that's done proving? Comment: INDRA or FREE. That's one god inside you named. Every part of you has one — follow Gods of the Mind and we'll meet them all, one at a time, until you see the whole of yourself.

comment: Indra is the most relatable god in all of Hindu wisdom — powerful, brilliant, and quietly terrified of being replaced. 🌩️ Be honest: do you feel him in you? I read and reply to every comment.
